notes: Positive damping 0.03; deterministic standard fit. Wall times include harness conversion and Metal process startup and file I/O. Memory is MiB; methods differ and are not directly comparable. Child RSS is a cumulative high-water mark, so a delta is not a per-child peak. Relative difference is max absolute error divided by max absolute reference prediction. Large runtime is an unverified estimate.
